incidents.name: Platypus MasterPlatypusV4 emergencyWithdraw solvency check
incidents.notes: MasterPlatypusV4: emergencyWithdraw did not check outstanding USP debt, releasing collateral while keeping the borrowed USP. V4 deployed shortly before the exploit.

sources.ref: onchain review: MasterPlatypusV4 0xfF6934aAC9C94E1C39358D4fDCF70aeca77D0AB0 created 2022-09-05T08:54:11Z by 0xcd7874f7430f9f62129c3fef1bc8cb8ef7bad224, not the attack-tx sender 0xeff003d64046a6f521ba31f39405cb720e953958; one EIP-1967 Upgraded event, at block 22409704 on 2022-11-15T13:28:38Z installing 0xc007f27b757a782c833c568f5851ae1dfe0e6ec7, so the executing code was 93.2 days old. Loss ~$8.5M as previously recorded.

incidents.name: Platypus pool cash/liability accounting manipulation
incidents.notes: Platypus pool cash/liability accounting manipulated via deposit/swap/withdraw to inflate LP redemption value

sources.ref: onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xe5c84c7630a505b6adf69b5594d0ff7fedd5f447 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x4658ea7e9960d6158a261104aaa160cc953bb6ba, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (7913401s -> 7910954s)
